title: SkyFrostFast
description: This is a Modpack designed for the SkyFrost server, aimed at enhancing the players' gaming experience and FPS.
body:
## ⚠️注意！此项目将不再更新，建议您不要再游玩SkyFrost服务器了。
## Introduction
As the introduction states, it is a Modpack focused on a fast-paced, FPS experience, which you can use to play on other servers, but I recommend using it specifically for the Skyfrost server.
It is in the development stage and may not have all the features yet, so please wait patiently.
